description: Experimental rule-based plank phase estimator. This is not a trained classifier.

capabilities.hip_high: Requires a validated signed pelvis-to-thorax angle threshold and correctly mounted upper/lower sensors.
capabilities.load_distribution: Unavailable: current hardware has one pressure channel, not arm and foot force channels.
capabilities.lateral_balance: Unavailable as a validated balance classifier: requires bilateral sensors and labeled trials.
capabilities.excessive_arch: Requires a validated signed pelvis-to-thorax angle threshold and correctly mounted upper/lower sensors.
